exams.name: Accredited Adviser in Insurance
exams.blurb: Agency-focused designation programme covering personal and commercial account development, coverage analysis and agency operations.

exams.name: Accredited Adviser in Insurance-Management
exams.blurb: Management extension of the agency adviser designation, adding leadership and strategic agency management coursework.

exams.name: Accredited Customer Service Representative
exams.blurb: Early-career designation programme for agency service staff covering personal lines, commercial lines and errors and omissions risk.

exams.name: Associate in Commercial Underwriting
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering commercial underwriting principles, risk selection, pricing and portfolio management technique.

exams.name: Associate in Commercial Underwriting-Management
exams.blurb: One additional management course beyond the commercial underwriting designation, focused on leading underwriting teams.

exams.name: Associate in Fidelity and Surety Bonding
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering contract and commercial surety, fidelity bonds, crime insurance and underwriting of bond risk.

exams.name: Associate in Information Technology
exams.blurb: Designation programme on aligning insurance operations with information technology, systems, data management and security.

exams.name: Associate in Insurance
exams.blurb: Foundational designation programme covering insurance principles, policy structure, coverages and operations across lines of business.

exams.name: Associate in Insurance Accounting and Finance
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering statutory accounting, insurer financial statements, NAIC reporting requirements and solvency measures.

exams.name: Associate in Insurance Data Analytics
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering data literacy, analytics tools and the use of data across underwriting, claims and distribution.

exams.name: Associate in Insurance Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme focused on service quality, customer experience and delivering dynamic insurance services to policyholders.

exams.name: Associate in Management
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering team leadership, organisational behaviour and managing strategic threats within insurance firms.

exams.name: Associate in Marine Insurance Management
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering ocean and inland marine insurance, hull, cargo, liability exposures and marine claim practice.

exams.name: Associate in National Flood Insurance
exams.blurb: Designation programme on the National Flood Insurance Program, flood zone rating, policy forms and flood claim handling.

exams.name: Associate in Personal Insurance
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering personal lines products, underwriting, marketing practice and the personal insurance environment.

exams.name: Associate in Premium Auditing
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering premium audit procedures, classification systems, insurance accounting and audit report preparation.

exams.name: Associate in Regulation and Compliance
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering insurance regulation, market conduct examinations and building an insurer compliance function.

exams.name: Associate in Reinsurance
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering treaty and facultative reinsurance, pricing, contract wording and reinsurance programme design.

exams.name: Associate in Risk Management
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering risk identification, analysis, control, financing and monitoring across an organisation.

exams.name: Associate in Surplus Lines Insurance
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering the excess and surplus lines market, non-admitted regulation, wholesale broking and unique exposures.

exams.name: Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter Designation
exams.blurb: Designation programme of five core course exams plus a commercial or personal concentration, ethics and matriculation requirements.

exams.name: CPCU 500: Becoming a Leader in Risk Management and Insurance
exams.blurb: Core CPCU course exam on risk essentials, critical thinking, insurance as a risk solution and strategic decision making.

exams.name: CPCU 520: Meeting Challenges Across Insurance Operations
exams.blurb: Core CPCU course exam on the insurance value chain, claims, underwriting, marketing, reinsurance and the actuarial role.

exams.name: CPCU 530: Applying Legal Concepts to Insurance
exams.blurb: Core CPCU course exam on contract and tort law, policy interpretation, property ownership, agency law and dispute resolution.

exams.name: CPCU 540: Contributing to Insurer Financial Performance
exams.blurb: Core CPCU course exam on insurer financial statements, key ratios, investment decisions and strategic capital management.

exams.name: CPCU 550: Maximizing Value with Data and Technology
exams.blurb: Core CPCU course exam on insurance data sources, analytics foundations, risk modelling and the ethics of data use.

exams.name: CPCU 551: Managing Commercial Property Risk
exams.blurb: Commercial concentration exam on building and personal property coverage, business income, inland transit and crime losses.

exams.name: CPCU 552: Managing Commercial Liability Risk
exams.blurb: Commercial concentration exam on general liability, business auto, cyber exposures, workplace risk and liability coverage gaps.

exams.name: CPCU 555: Advancing Personal Insurance Products
exams.blurb: Personal concentration exam on home and personal auto loss exposures, life and health gaps and personal investment strategy.

exams.name: CPCU 556: Building a Competitive Edge in Personal Lines
exams.blurb: Personal concentration exam on personal lines marketing, underwriting strategy, portfolio assessment and expense control.

exams.name: CPCU Matriculation and Ethics Requirement
exams.blurb: Short online requirement covering the CPCU canons of ethics and validation of professional experience before the designation is awarded.

exams.name: Professional Risk Consultant
exams.blurb: Early-career designation programme preparing producers and consultants to analyse client exposures and recommend risk solutions.

exams.name: Associate in Claims
exams.blurb: Designation programme of course examinations covering property, liability and workers compensation claim handling and negotiation.

exams.name: Associate in Claims-Management
exams.blurb: One additional management course beyond the Associate in Claims, focused on leading claim teams and improving claim outcomes.

exams.name: Senior Professional Public Adjuster
exams.blurb: National designation programme for public adjusters covering policy analysis, damage estimating, documentation and claim advocacy.

exams.name: Workers Compensation Claims Administration Certificate
exams.blurb: Three-course certificate covering the workers compensation regulatory landscape, claim handling and claim investigation technique.
